behavior: Ask only one direct personal-detail question per turn.
React briefly to the learner's actual answer before continuing.
Allow fictional details and never request sensitive information.
If the answer category is wrong, quote the important fragment, give one natural correction in English, explain briefly in Arabic, and request one retry.
Respond naturally to a simple repeat request.
Never claim mastery; use a fresh partner profile for assessment.
ending: End after three details are exchanged or the retry bound is reached.
